::: {#exm-positional-encoding}

#### Order matters once positions are added

```{python}
#| code-fold: show
_ = torch.manual_seed(0)
position = nn.Embedding(13, 8)
where = torch.arange(13)
with torch.no_grad():
    x_pos = embed(line) + position(where)
    x_pos_reversed = embed(line.flip(1)) + position(where)
    pos_out, _ = attend(x_pos, x_pos, x_pos)
    pos_reversed, _ = attend(x_pos_reversed, x_pos_reversed, x_pos_reversed)
pos_gap = (pos_reversed - pos_out.flip(1)).abs().max().item()
print(pos_gap)
```

With a learned [positional encoding](#def-positional-encoding) added to each character's vector,
the outputs for the reversed line are no longer the old outputs reversed:
the largest difference is `r sprintf("%.2f", py$pos_gap)`,
against `r sprintf("%.1g", py$reverse_gap)` without it.

:::
